g.text: Same host skips the tunnel; different hosts use it
Tested: 20 pings between two replicas on one node left vxlan0 at tx_packets 0 -> 0, while br0 carried them.
no VXLAN, no UDP 4789, no encapsulation overhead
adds ~50 bytes per packet + CPU for wrap/unwrap. Placing chatty replicas on one node (placement constraints) avoids it; Swarm does not do this for you.
